title: Effects of customized corneal cross‐linking on higher‐order aberrations in progressive keratoconus and low‐grade myopia

groups.description: Customized epithelium-on CXL in high oxygen (Mosaic system, ParaCel riboflavin, humidified 100% oxygen, pulsed 30 mW/cm2 UVA, peak dose 7.2/10/15 J/cm2 by Kmax plus 5.4 J/cm2 over a 6-mm vertex-centred zone) for progressive keratoconus; 38 eyes of 38 patients (one eye per patient), treated and followed prospectively; the article declares the myopia eyes as its control group, so this keratoconus arm is the arm receiving the evaluated technique; no cataract or other surgery in the described session

series.notes: mean in row 18 with SD in parentheses in row 19; BSCVA with a standard logMAR chart, ETDRS-fast protocol (Methods); eyes missing per visit in Table 1 row 23 (KC columns C2, C4, C6, C8, C10): one patient missing at each of the 1-12-month visits and nine at 24 months (Methods), i.e. ordinary attrition

exclusions.what: Myopia group (23 eyes of 23 patients, central 4-mm annular CXL for low-grade myopia; Table 1 Myopia columns C3, C5, C7, C9, C11)
exclusions.reason: healthy (non-diseased) corneas treated for low-grade myopia: the brief excludes healthy eyes and the protocol's corneal indications have no refractive-only category; in addition the group was selected retrospectively for a complete set of good-quality postoperative Pentacam measurements at a maximum number of visits (selection on postoperative data, protocol inclusion 5)
low-contrast acuity is not the corrected distance (high-contrast) acuity of protocol inclusion 1

exclusions.what: 95% CI, p-value and Cohen's d rows (Table 1 rows 20-22) and correlations (Table 2)

notes: Table 1 also tabulates vertical coma, horizontal coma and spherical aberration; keratometry, astigmatism and trefoil are reported in the text; none of these is used.
Mixed design: the keratoconus arm was prospective; the myopia arm was collected retrospectively from earlier published studies.

Role 'treated' because the article declares the myopia eyes as its control group and the keratoconus arm receives the evaluated customized epithelium-on CXL; there is no standard-care keratoconus arm.
